stories.headline: Lula wins re-election as Brazil's president
stories.summary: Brazil held the second round of its presidential election on the last Sunday of October. Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won re-election 52 to 48 percent, defeating Flávio Bolsonaro for a fourth non-consecutive term. He had trailed in the first round, taking 45% of the vote against his rival's 47%.

stories.headline: Greater Sydney's second airport takes its first passengers
stories.summary: Western Sydney Airport in New South Wales began passenger operations on 25 October, as Greater Sydney's second airport. The first domestic flight to depart was a Jetstar service to the Gold Coast, which left at 11 am. The airport is named in honour of the Australian aviator Nancy Bird Walton.

stories.headline: Yuri Yoshida takes her first LPGA Tour title
stories.summary: Japan's Yuri Yoshida has won the BMW Ladies Championship in South Korea, her first title on the LPGA Tour. She finished ahead of Australia's Minjee Lee and South Korea's Kim Sei-young. Yoshida had already won four times on the LPGA of Japan Tour.

stories.headline: Spinosaurus spent most of its time under water
stories.summary: A new study of fossil and modern skeletons concludes that Spinosaurus spent the vast majority of its time submerged in water. The dinosaur lived approximately 113 million to 94 million years ago, in what is now northern Africa. To judge whether an extinct animal had limbs modified for swimming, the team revived a statistical method from the 1940s.
